name: Use class weights for moderate imbalance

conditions.description: The target classes are moderately imbalanced.

recommendation: Use class weights or threshold tuning.
reason_template: The classification target is imbalanced, so class-aware training can improve minority-class performance.
limitations: May not fully solve severe imbalance

name: Consider SMOTE for strong imbalance

conditions.description: The target classes are strongly imbalanced.

recommendation: Consider SMOTE inside the training pipeline.
reason_template: The minority class is very small, so synthetic oversampling can improve learning if applied only after the train/test split.
limitations: Must be applied only inside training folds
